rejection_summary.title: The Princess
rejection_summary.reason: Although the 94-minute castle escape contains repeated sword and hand-to-hand fights, RogerEbert.com's whole-film review reports flashback interruptions and a stop-start pattern, while other reviews criticize repeated encounters in a confined castle and weak presentation. Its action is not assumed to be absent, but sustained density and sufficient variation are less secure than for the shortlisted film; withheld from this research packet rather than inventing a strong fit.
